title: Tailwise Autoship Shipment Share on Freight Service-Failure Refunds
content:
**Training note - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, Large Item Freight Delivery.**

The service-failure refund on a freight order carries an Autoship share that depends on the Tailwise Autoship shipments charged to the customer within the Autoship look-back window. The share is added to the service-failure share before the freight fee is multiplied by it.

| Tailwise Autoship shipments charged within the Autoship look-back window | Autoship share added |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 6% |
| At least 6 but fewer than 12 | 2% |
| Fewer than 6 | Nothing |

### Questions answered

**Which entries count?** Shipment charges on the customer's Tailwise Autoship record, on any of the customer's Autoship subscriptions, dated within the Autoship look-back window. Skips, payment declines, claim refunds and reships are not shipment charges.

**What about exactly 6 or exactly 12 shipments?** The threshold number belongs to the higher band: 6 shipments add 2%, 12 shipments add 6%. Five shipments add nothing; 11 add 2%.

**Is the share a percentage of the order total?** No. It is a share added to the service-failure share, which is then applied to the freight fee charged on the order.

**Example (hypothetical).** A customer with 9 Autoship shipment charges inside the window adds 2%; a starting share of 20% with no other addition would become 22%.
